description_en: Queries the processing status and results of a batch device registration request
description_zh: 调用该接口查询批量注册设备申请的处理状态和结果
name: QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter has no value, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices you want to query belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的设备所属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The application batch ID that you want to query.

The application batch ID is returned after you successfully call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69482.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的申请批次ID。

申请批次ID在成功调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69482.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html接口的返回结果中
parameters.name: apply_id

Code.description_en:
The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）.

Currently, only the China (Shanghai) region supports X.509 certificates for devices. If the region is not China (Shanghai), X.509 certificates cannot be generated, and the error code iot.device.RegionNotSupportX509 is returned
Code.description_zh:
调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）。

目前仅华东2（cn-shanghai）地域支持设备X.509证书，如果地域不是华东2（cn-shanghai），则不能生成X.509证书，返回错误码iot.device.RegionNotSupportX509

Data.description_en: The status information returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的状态信息

Status.description_en:
The processing status and result of the application. Valid values:

CHECK: Device names are being verified.

CHECK_SUCCESS: All device names in the application pass the verification.

CHECK_FAILED: Some device names in the application fail the verification.

CREATE: Devices are being created.

CREATE_SUCCESS: All devices in the application are created.
If the authentication type of the product to which the devices belong is X.509 certificate, this value indicates that all devices and corresponding X.509 certificates are created.

CREATE_FAILED: Some devices in the application fail to be created.

If the authentication type of the product to which the devices belong is X.509, this value is returned when any device or X.509 certificate in the current batch fails to be created
Status.description_zh:
申请单的处理状态和结果，取值：

CHECK：正在校验设备名称。

CHECK_SUCCESS：申请单中的所有设备名称校验成功。

CHECK_FAILED：申请单中有设备名称校验失败。

CREATE：正在创建设备。

CREATE_SUCCESS：申请单中的所有设备创建成功。
当设备所属产品的认证类型是X.509证书时，表示所有设备和对应的X.509证书都创建成功。

CREATE_FAILED：申请单中有设备创建失败。

当设备所属产品的认证类型是X.509时，只要当前批次中，任意一个设备或X.509证书创建失败，则返回创建失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
